arguments.query: small business need help with data analysis or reporting

results.text: A repair business has conflicting public descriptions of what its standard service includes, and customers keep asking the same questions.
A specialty seller has duplicated and inconsistent product descriptions across several public listings.

arguments.scope: Review the repair business's public-facing materials (website, listings, social profiles) to identify all conflicting statements about what the standard service includes. Deliver a single clear, consistent service description document (standard scope, inclusions/exclusions, common add-ons) plus a short FAQ addressing the top repeat customer questions, ready to paste into their website and listings.

Review the specialty seller's public product listings to identify duplicated and inconsistent descriptions across platforms. Deliver a single master set of clean, consistent product descriptions (one per product) reconciling naming, specs, and claims, ready to paste into each listing, plus a short list of the specific inconsistencies found and fixed.

discovered_signals.text: A volunteer group says its donation and attendance records are spread across several inconsistent spreadsheets.
A repair business has conflicting public descriptions of what its standard service includes, and customers keep asking the same questions.
Customers of a seasonal service complain that appointment availability and expected response times are unclear.
Reviews for a small retailer repeatedly disagree about available products, pickup rules, and current opening hours.
A specialty seller has duplicated and inconsistent product descriptions across several public listings.

offers.scope: Review the repair business's public-facing materials (website, listings, social profiles) to identify all conflicting statements about what the standard service includes. Deliver a single clear, consistent service description document (standard scope, inclusions/exclusions, common add-ons) plus a short FAQ addressing the top repeat customer questions, ready to paste into their website and listings.

Review the specialty seller's public product listings to identify duplicated and inconsistent descriptions across platforms. Deliver a single master set of clean, consistent product descriptions (one per product) reconciling naming, specs, and claims, ready to paste into each listing, plus a short list of the specific inconsistencies found and fixed.

Review the small retailer's public listings and review mentions to identify conflicting statements about available products, pickup rules, and opening hours. Deliver a single consistent reference document (current product availability, pickup rules, opening hours) ready to paste into the store's website/listings, plus a short list of the specific inconsistencies found and fixed.

Review the volunteer group's donation and attendance spreadsheets to identify inconsistencies across them. Deliver a single reconciled master spreadsheet/summary (consistent donor and attendance records) plus a short list of the specific inconsistencies found and fixed.
